chores.full: pij list --json 2>/dev/null | jq -r "(if type==\"array\" then . else .sessions end)[] | select(.folder==\"/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass\") | select(.semanticState==\"hold\" or .semanticState==\"waiting\" or .semanticState==\"question\") | select(.activity==\"working\") | \"CONTRADICTION \" + .id + \": declares \" + .semanticState + \" but activity=\" + .activity"; echo "note: blocked is excluded by design — it names an external dependency, so blocked+working is expected"
